sanskrit: saṃvidhāya yathādiṣṭaṃ yathādeśapradarśanam kṛtacintā nyavartanta te ca nāgapuraṃ prati
english: Having made arrangements as instructed and having shown themselves in their respective regions, having completed their deliberations, they then turned back toward Nāgapura.

sanskrit: tatra dṛṣṭvā tu rājānaṃ kauravyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajam droṇakarṇakṛpaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhīṣmeṇa ca mahātmanā
english: There, having seen the Kaurava king, the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, assembled together with Droṇa, Karṇa, and Kṛpa, and with the great-souled Bhīṣma,

sanskrit: saṃgataṃ bhrātṛbhiś cāpi trigartaiś ca mahārathaiḥ duryodhanaṃ sabhāmadhye āsīnam idam abruvan
english: gathered with his brothers and with the Trigarta great chariot warriors, they addressed Duryodhana who was seated in the midst of the assembly, saying this:

sanskrit: kṛto 'smābhiḥ paro yatnas teṣām anveṣaṇe sadā pāṇḍavānāṃ manuṣyendra tasmin mahati kānane
english: "O lord of men, we have always made the greatest effort in searching for the Pāṇḍavas in that great forest,

sanskrit: nirjane mṛgasaṃkīrṇe nānādrumalatāvṛte latāpratānabahule nānāgulmasamāvṛte
english: which is desolate and filled with deer, covered with many kinds of trees and creepers, thick with spreading vines, and overgrown with all manner of shrubs.

sanskrit: na ca vidmo gatā yena pārthāḥ syur dṛḍhavikramāḥ mārgamāṇāḥ padanyāsaṃ teṣu teṣu tathā tathā
english: Yet we do not know by which route the Pārthas, those of firm valor, may have gone — searching here and there in every direction for their footprints.

sanskrit: girikūṭeṣu tuṅgeṣu nānājanapadeṣu ca janākīrṇeṣu deśeṣu kharvaṭeṣu pureṣu ca
english: On lofty mountain peaks, in various kingdoms, in thickly populated regions, in villages, and in cities —

sanskrit: narendra bahuśo 'nviṣṭā naiva vidmaś ca pāṇḍavān atyantabhāvaṃ naṣṭās te bhadraṃ tubhyaṃ nararṣabha
english: O lord of men, we have searched repeatedly and still we do not find the Pāṇḍavas. They have vanished utterly. May it be well with you, O bull among men.

sanskrit: vartmāny anviṣyamāṇās tu rathānāṃ rathasattama kaṃ cit kālaṃ manuṣyendra sūtānām anugā vayam
english: O best of chariot warriors, O lord of men, for a time we followed in the tracks of chariots and the paths of charioteers while searching their routes.

sanskrit: mṛgayitvā yathānyāyaṃ viditārthāḥ sma tattvataḥ prāptā dvāravatīṃ sūtā ṛte pārthaiḥ paraṃtapa
english: Having searched as was proper and having come to know the truth of the matter, the charioteers arrived at Dvāravatī without the Pārthas, O scorcher of foes.

sanskrit: na tatra pāṇḍavā rājan nāpi kṛṣṇā pativratā sarvathā vipranaṣṭās te namas te bharatarṣabha
english: The Pāṇḍavas were not there, O king, nor was Kṛṣṇā the devoted wife. They have disappeared altogether. We bow to you, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: na hi vidmo gatiṃ teṣāṃ vāsaṃ vāpi mahātmanām pāṇḍavānāṃ pravṛttiṃ vā vidmaḥ karmāpi vā kṛtam sa naḥ śādhi manuṣyendra ata ūrdhvaṃ viśāṃ pate
english: We do not know the movement of those great-souled Pāṇḍavas, nor their dwelling, nor their doings, nor the deeds done by them. Instruct us, O lord of men, O lord of people, as to what we should do hereafter.

sanskrit: anveṣaṇe pāṇḍavānāṃ bhūyaḥ kiṃ karavāmahe imāṃ ca naḥ priyām īkṣa vācaṃ bhadravatīṃ śubhām
english: What more shall we do in the search for the Pāṇḍavas? Hear also this pleasing, auspicious, and agreeable speech from us.

sanskrit: yena trigartā nikṛtā balena mahatā nṛpa sūtena rājño matsyasya kīcakena mahātmanā
english: O king, Kīcaka, the great charioteer, the commander of King Matsya's forces — he by whose great power the Trigartas were brought low —

sanskrit: sa hataḥ patitaḥ śete gandharvair niśi bhārata adṛśyamānair duṣṭātmā saha bhrātṛbhir acyuta
english: that wicked-souled one has been slain and lies fallen, O Bhārata, O Acyuta, killed at night by invisible Gandharvas together with his brothers.

sanskrit: priyam etad upaśrutya śatrūṇāṃ tu parābhavam kṛtakṛtyaś ca kauravya vidhatsva yad anantaram
english: Having heard this delightful news of the enemy's defeat, O Kauravya, consider yourself accomplished and decide what should be done next."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato duryodhano rājā śrutvā teṣāṃ vacas tadā ciram antarmanā bhūtvā pratyuvāca sabhāsadaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then King Duryodhana, having heard their words, became absorbed in his own thoughts for a long while and then replied to those assembled in the hall:

sanskrit: suduḥkhā khalu kāryāṇāṃ gatir vijñātum antataḥ tasmāt sarve udīkṣadhvaṃ kva nu syuḥ pāṇḍavā gatāḥ
english: "It is indeed very difficult to know in the end where affairs will lead. Therefore let all of you reflect carefully on where the Pāṇḍavas might have gone.

sanskrit: alpāvaśiṣṭaṃ kālasya gatabhūyiṣṭham antataḥ teṣām ajñātacaryāyām asmin varṣe trayodaśe
english: In this thirteenth year, the greater part of the time of their life of incognito has already passed; only a little time remains at the end.

sanskrit: asya varṣasya śeṣaṃ ced vyatīyur iha pāṇḍavāḥ nivṛttasamayās te hi satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ
english: If the Pāṇḍavas, devoted as they are to their vow of truth, pass through what remains of this year, their term of exile would be completed.

sanskrit: kṣaranta iva nāgendrāḥ sarva āśīviṣopamāḥ duḥkhā bhaveyuḥ saṃrabdhāḥ kauravān prati te dhruvam
english: Like mighty elephants in musth, all of them resembling venomous serpents, they will surely become fierce and terrible toward the Kauravas, filled with rage.

sanskrit: arvāk kālasya vijñātāḥ kṛcchrarūpadharāḥ punaḥ praviśeyur jitakrodhās te tāvad eva punar vanam
english: But if they are discovered before the time is up while still wearing their disguise, having subdued their anger, they would then have to enter the forest once more for the same duration.

sanskrit: tasmāt kṣipraṃ bubhutsadhvaṃ yathā no 'tyantam avyayam rājyaṃ nirdvandvam avyagraṃ niḥsapatnaṃ ciraṃ bhavet
english: Therefore, quickly seek to find out how our kingdom may remain permanently ours, undisputed, untroubled, free of rivals, and enduring."

sanskrit: athābravīt tataḥ karṇaḥ kṣipraṃ gacchantu bhārata anye dhūrtatarā dakṣā nibhṛtāḥ sādhukāriṇaḥ
english: Then Karṇa spoke: "O Bhārata, let others who are more clever, capable, discreet, and efficient go quickly.

sanskrit: carantu deśān saṃvītāḥ sphītāñ janapadākulān tatra goṣṭhīṣv athānyāsu siddhapravrajiteṣu ca
english: Let them travel through the prosperous and populous provinces in disguise, in gatherings there and elsewhere, among ascetics and wandering mendicants.

sanskrit: paricāreṣu tīrtheṣu vividheṣv ākareṣu ca vijñātavyā manuṣyais tais tarkayā suvinītayā
english: In pleasure grounds, at various sacred fords, and at different sources of wealth, they are to be identified by those men through well-trained inference and deduction.

sanskrit: vividhais tatparaiḥ samyak tajjñair nipuṇasaṃvṛtaiḥ anveṣṭavyāś ca nipuṇaṃ pāṇḍavāś channavāsinaḥ
english: By various means, by men fully intent on the task, expert in their knowledge, subtle and concealed, the Pāṇḍavas living in disguise are to be searched for with great skill.

sanskrit: nadīkuñjeṣu tīrtheṣu grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca āśrameṣu ca ramyeṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca
english: In forest thickets along rivers, at sacred fords, in villages and cities, in pleasant hermitages, on mountains, and in caves —

sanskrit: athāgrajānantarajaḥ pāpabhāvānurāgiṇam jyeṣṭhaṃ duḥśāsanas tatra bhrātā bhrātaram abravīt
english: Then Duḥśāsana, the one born next after the eldest, addressed his elder brother who was inclined to sinful thoughts, saying:

sanskrit: etac ca karṇo yat prāha sarvam īkṣāmahe tathā yathoddiṣṭaṃ carāḥ sarve mṛgayantu tatas tataḥ ete cānye ca bhūyāṃso deśād deśaṃ yathāvidhi
english: "All that Karṇa has said — let us look into it. Let all the spies search as directed here and there. These and many other more numerous agents should go from region to region according to procedure.

sanskrit: na tu teṣāṃ gatir vāsaḥ pravṛttiś copalabhyate atyāhitaṃ vā gūḍhās te pāraṃ vormimato gatāḥ
english: Yet their movement, their dwelling, and their activities are not to be detected; or perhaps, in hiding, they have gone to the far shore of the wave-tossed ocean.

sanskrit: vyālair vāpi mahāraṇye bhakṣitāḥ śūramāninaḥ atha vā viṣamaṃ prāpya vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
english: Or perhaps those who fancy themselves heroes have been devoured by tigers in the great forest, or having met with some calamity, they have perished for all time.

sanskrit: tasmān mānasam avyagraṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ kurunandana kuru kāryaṃ yathotsāhaṃ manyase yan narādhipa
english: Therefore, O joy of the Kurus, O lord of men, with an undisturbed mind, do whatever work you consider appropriate with whatever energy you have."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca athābravīn mahāvīryo droṇas tattvārthadarśivān na tādṛśā vinaśyanti nāpi yānti parābhavam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Droṇa, the greatly valiant one who sees the true meaning of things, spoke: "Such men do not perish, nor do they come to defeat.

sanskrit: śūrāś ca kṛtavidyāś ca buddhimanto jitendriyāḥ dharmajñāś ca kṛtajñāś ca dharmarājam anuvratāḥ
english: They are brave, learned in all knowledge, wise, masters of their senses, knowing dharma, grateful, and devoted to the king of dharma.

sanskrit: nītidharmārthatattvajñaṃ pitṛvac ca samāhitam dharme sthitaṃ satyadhṛtiṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāpacāyinam
english: They follow the eldest who is the knower of the true nature of statecraft, dharma, and wealth, who is as steady as a father, established in righteousness, firm in truth, and who reverences the eldest.

sanskrit: anuvratā mahātmānaṃ bhrātaraṃ bhrātaro nṛpa ajātaśatruṃ hrīmantaṃ taṃ ca bhrātṝn anuvratam
english: O king, brothers devoted to the great-souled brother — to the one who has no enemies, who is full of modesty — and he in turn devoted to his brothers:

sanskrit: teṣāṃ tathā vidheyānāṃ nibhṛtānāṃ mahātmanām kimarthaṃ nītimān pārthaḥ śreyo naiṣāṃ kariṣyati
english: why should the wise Pārtha not bring about the welfare of those great-souled ones who are thus disciplined and discreet?

sanskrit: tasmād yatnāt pratīkṣante kālasyodayam āgatam na hi te nāśam ṛccheyur iti paśyāmy ahaṃ dhiyā
english: Therefore with effort they await the arrival of their proper time. I see by my understanding that they surely cannot come to ruin.

sanskrit: sāṃprataṃ caiva yat kāryaṃ tac ca kṣipram akālikam kriyatāṃ sādhu saṃcintya vāsaś caiṣāṃ pracintyatām
english: And whatever needs to be done now, without delay — let it be done quickly after due deliberation, and let their place of dwelling also be thought over carefully.

sanskrit: yathāvat pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ sarvārtheṣu dhṛtātmanām durjñeyāḥ khalu śūrās te apāpās tapasā vṛtāḥ
english: The sons of Pāṇḍu, steadfast in all matters, blameless, endowed with austerity — those heroes are indeed difficult to track in their proper form.

sanskrit: śuddhātmā guṇavān pārthaḥ satyavān nītimāñ śuciḥ tejorāśir asaṃkhyeyo gṛhṇīyād api cakṣuṣī
english: Pārtha is pure-souled, virtuous, truthful, wise, and pure; he is an immeasurable mass of brilliance that could captivate even the eyes of others.

sanskrit: vijñāya kriyatāṃ tasmād bhūyaś ca mṛgayāmahe brāhmaṇaiś cārakaiḥ siddhair ye cānye tadvido janāḥ
english: Therefore, having understood this, let action be taken; and let us search further through learned Brahmins, accomplished spies, and others who have knowledge of such matters."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmo bharatānāṃ pitāmahaḥ śrutavān deśakālajñas tattvajñaḥ sarvadharmavit
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Bhīṣma, the son of Śaṃtanu, the grandfather of the Bhāratas, learned, knowing time and place, knowing truth, and versed in all dharma,

sanskrit: ācāryavākyoparame tad vākyam abhisaṃdadhat hitārthaṃ sa uvācemāṃ bhāratīṃ bhāratān prati
english: when the teacher's speech had ended, taking up that speech and joining it to his own for the sake of their welfare, he spoke this address to the Bhāratas:

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhire samāsaktāṃ dharmajñe dharmasaṃśritām asatsu durlabhāṃ nityaṃ satāṃ cābhimatāṃ sadā bhīṣmaḥ samavadat tatra giraṃ sādhubhir arcitām
english: Bhīṣma there spoke a speech anchored in Yudhiṣṭhira, the knower of dharma, resting on dharma, ever rare among the wicked, always beloved of the good — a speech honored by the virtuous.

sanskrit: yathaiṣa brāhmaṇaḥ prāha droṇaḥ sarvārthatattvavit sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā nāśaṃ nārhanti pāṇḍavāḥ
english: "Just as this Brahmin Droṇa, who knows the true nature of all things, has said: the Pāṇḍavas, endowed with all auspicious marks, do not deserve destruction.

sanskrit: śrutavṛttopasaṃpannāḥ sādhuvratasamanvitāḥ vṛddhānuśāsane magnāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ
english: They are furnished with learning and good conduct, endowed with virtuous vows, immersed in the teaching of their elders, and devoted to their vow of truth.

sanskrit: samayaṃ samayajñās te pālayantaḥ śucivratāḥ nāvasīditum arhanti udvahantaḥ satāṃ dhuram
english: Knowing the proper time, observing their pure vows, upholding the burden of the righteous — they do not deserve to sink in despair.

sanskrit: dharmataś caiva guptās te svavīryeṇa ca pāṇḍavāḥ na nāśam adhigaccheyur iti me dhīyate matiḥ
english: Protected both by dharma and by their own valor, the Pāṇḍavas cannot come to ruin — this is how my thinking stands.

sanskrit: tatra buddhiṃ praṇeṣyāmi pāṇḍavān prati bhārata na tu nītiḥ sunītasya śakyate 'nveṣituṃ paraiḥ
english: I shall direct my understanding toward the matter of the Pāṇḍavas, O Bhārata; yet the policy of one who is truly wise cannot be traced by others.

sanskrit: yat tu śakyam ihāsmābhis tān vai saṃcintya pāṇḍavān buddhyā pravaktuṃ na drohāt pravakṣyāmi nibodha tat
english: But what I am able to say here, having thought carefully about those Pāṇḍavas — I will speak through understanding, not through hostility. Hear that.

sanskrit: sā tv iyaṃ sādhu vaktavyā na tv anītiḥ kathaṃ cana vṛddhānuśāsane tāta tiṣṭhataḥ satyaśīlinaḥ
english: And what is to be said should be said well — there should be no injustice at all — for one who abides by the teaching of elders, O dear one, and whose nature is truth.

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ tv iha dhīreṇa satāṃ madhye vivakṣatā yathāmati vivaktavyaṃ sarvaśo dharmalipsayā
english: Surely the steadfast man who wishes to speak in the midst of the virtuous must speak in every way according to his understanding, out of desire for dharma.

sanskrit: tatra nāhaṃ tathā manye yathāyam itaro janaḥ pure janapade vāpi yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: In this matter I do not think as these others do: in whatever city or province King Yudhiṣṭhira resides —

sanskrit: nāsūyako na cāpīrṣur nātivādī na matsarī bhaviṣyati janas tatra svaṃ svaṃ dharmam anuvrataḥ
english: the people there will not be envious, nor jealous, nor given to excessive speech, nor spiteful; they will each follow their own dharma.

sanskrit: brahmaghoṣāś ca bhūyāṃsaḥ pūrṇāhutyas tathaiva ca kratavaś ca bhaviṣyanti bhūyāṃso bhūridakṣiṇāḥ
english: The chanting of the Vedas will increase greatly, as will complete oblations; and sacrifices will be many, with abundant gifts.

sanskrit: sadā ca tatra parjanyaḥ samyag varṣī na saṃśayaḥ saṃpannasasyā ca mahī nirītīkā bhaviṣyati
english: And there the rain-cloud will always shower in due season, without doubt; the earth will be rich with crops and free from calamities.

sanskrit: rasavanti ca dhānyāni guṇavanti phalāni ca gandhavanti ca mālyāni śubhaśabdā ca bhāratī
english: The grains will be full of sap, the fruits rich in virtue, the garlands fragrant, and the speech auspicious.

sanskrit: vāyuś ca sukhasaṃsparśo niṣpratīpaṃ ca darśanam bhayaṃ nābhyāviśet tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: The wind will be pleasant to the touch, and the sight will be without obstruction; fear will not enter there where King Yudhiṣṭhira dwells.

sanskrit: gāvaś ca bahulās tatra na kṛśā na ca durduhāḥ payāṃsi dadhisarpīṃṣi rasavanti hitāni ca
english: Cows will be plentiful there, neither lean nor hard to milk; milk, curds, and clarified butter will be full of taste and wholesome.

sanskrit: guṇavanti ca pānāni bhojyāni rasavanti ca tatra deśe bhaviṣyanti yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: The drinks will be virtuous and the foods full of flavor — these things will exist in whatever region King Yudhiṣṭhira dwells.

sanskrit: rasāḥ sparśāś ca gandhāś ca śabdāś cāpi guṇānvitāḥ dṛśyāni ca prasannāni yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Tastes, textures, fragrances, sounds — all endowed with virtue — and all sights will be pleasant, wherever King Yudhiṣṭhira is.

sanskrit: svaiḥ svair guṇaiḥ susaṃyuktās tasmin varṣe trayodaśe deśe tasmin bhaviṣyanti tāta pāṇḍavasaṃyute
english: Endowed each with their own proper qualities, in this thirteenth year, these things will exist in the region that shelters the Pāṇḍavas, dear one.

sanskrit: saṃprītimāñ janas tatra saṃtuṣṭaḥ śucir avyayaḥ devatātithipūjāsu sarvabhūtānurāgavān
english: The people there will be affectionate, satisfied, pure, and steadfast, loving in the worship of gods and guests, and kindly toward all beings.

sanskrit: iṣṭadāno mahotsāhaḥ śaśvad dharmaparāyaṇaḥ aśubhadviṭ śubhaprepsur nityayajñaḥ śubhavrataḥ bhaviṣyati janas tatra yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Generous in giving, greatly enthusiastic, forever devoted to dharma, hating what is inauspicious, seeking what is auspicious, always sacrificing, observing auspicious vows — such will the people be wherever King Yudhiṣṭhira dwells.

sanskrit: tyaktavākyānṛtas tāta śubhakalyāṇamaṅgalaḥ śubhārthepsuḥ śubhamatir yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhaviṣyati janas tatra nityaṃ ceṣṭapriyavrataḥ
english: Having abandoned falsehood in speech, dear one, auspicious, propitious, and fortunate, seeking auspicious ends, thinking auspicious thoughts — wherever King Yudhiṣṭhira is, the people there will always observe vows pleasing to their desires.

sanskrit: dharmātmā sa tadādṛśyaḥ so 'pi tāta dvijātibhiḥ kiṃ punaḥ prākṛtaiḥ pārthaḥ śakyo vijñātum antataḥ
english: That dharma-souled one is thus invisible even to the twice-born in that form, dear one; how much less can the Pārtha be fully recognized by ordinary people?

sanskrit: yasmin satyaṃ dhṛtir dānaṃ parā śāntir dhruvā kṣamā hrīḥ śrīḥ kīrtiḥ paraṃ teja ānṛśaṃsyam athārjavam
english: In whom reside truth, steadiness, generosity, supreme peace, unfailing patience, modesty, prosperity, fame, the highest brilliance, non-cruelty, and straightforwardness —

sanskrit: tasmāt tatra nivāsaṃ tu channaṃ satreṇa dhīmataḥ gatiṃ vā paramāṃ tasya notsahe vaktum anyathā
english: therefore the concealed dwelling of that wise one, like a sacrifice hidden in disguise, or his supreme course — I do not venture to speak of it otherwise.

sanskrit: evam etat tu saṃcintya yatkṛtaṃ manyase hitam tat kṣipraṃ kuru kauravya yady evaṃ śraddadhāsi me
english: Having considered all this, whatever you think is for the good — do that quickly, O Kauravya, if you trust what I say."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ śāradvato vākyam ity uvāca kṛpas tadā yuktaṃ prāptaṃ ca vṛddhena pāṇḍavān prati bhāṣitam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Kṛpa, the son of Śaradvan, spoke thus: "Fitting and appropriate is what the elder has said regarding the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ tattvataś ca sahetumat tatrānurūpaṃ bhīṣmeṇa mamāpy atra giraṃ śṛṇu
english: Gracious, accompanied by dharma and artha, true, and well-reasoned — what Bhīṣma has said there is appropriate. Now hear my speech on this matter as well.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ caiva gatis tīrthair vāsaś caiṣāṃ pracintyatām nītir vidhīyatāṃ cāpi sāṃprataṃ yā hitā bhavet
english: Let the movements of those Pāṇḍavas through the sacred fords, and their dwelling, be considered carefully; and let whatever policy is now beneficial be determined.

sanskrit: nāvajñeyo ripus tāta prākṛto 'pi bubhūṣatā kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavās tāta sarvāstrakuśalā raṇe
english: O dear one, even an ordinary enemy is not to be despised by one who desires to prosper — how much less the Pāṇḍavas, dear one, who are skilled in all weapons in battle?

sanskrit: tasmāt satraṃ praviṣṭeṣu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu gūḍhabhāveṣu channeṣu kāle codayam āgate
english: Therefore, now that the great-souled Pāṇḍavas have entered their concealment, hidden and disguised, and the time of reckoning is approaching —

sanskrit: svarāṣṭrapararāṣṭreṣu jñātavyaṃ balam ātmanaḥ udaye pāṇḍavānāṃ ca prāpte kāle na saṃśayaḥ
english: one's own strength in one's own kingdom and in enemy kingdoms is to be known; and when the time of the Pāṇḍavas' rise is reached — there is no doubt about it.

sanskrit: nivṛttasamayāḥ pārthā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ mahotsāhā bhaviṣyanti pāṇḍavā hy atitejasaḥ
english: When their term is ended, the Pārthas, those great-souled, supremely powerful, and greatly energetic Pāṇḍavas of surpassing brilliance, will be roused to action.

sanskrit: tasmād balaṃ ca kośaṃ ca nītiś cāpi vidhīyatām yathā kālodaye prāpte samyak taiḥ saṃdadhāmahe
english: Therefore let military strength, treasury, and statecraft all be arranged so that when the time of reckoning arrives, we may properly come to terms with them.

sanskrit: tāta manyāmi tat sarvaṃ budhyasva balam ātmanaḥ niyataṃ sarvamitreṣu balavatsv abaleṣu ca
english: Dear one, I think all of this is so — understand your own strength, fixed as it is in relation to all your allies, the powerful and the weak alike."
